M01_reference.interpretation: Control: the frozen cutting_tasks_v1 provisional Plasticine-like recipe, unchanged.

M02_soft_elastic.interpretation: Soft elastic: E 2.5x lower and yield effectively disabled (1 MPa), so deformation is recoverable and larger under the same load.

M03_clay_plastic.interpretation: Clay-like plastic: same E, yield 2.5x lower (400 Pa, self-weight stress rho g H of a 16 mm bar is 235 Pa), so the blade leaves permanent plastic flow.

M04_firm.interpretation: Firmer deformable, the stiffest admissible at 0.1 ms: E 1.4x (70 kPa) and yield 3x (3 kPa); grid CFL 0.198.

M05_stiff_dt50us.interpretation: Stiffer deformable: E 3x (150 kPa), yield 5x (5 kPa). Grid CFL 0.29 at 0.1 ms is REFUSED; admitted at 50 us (0.145).

M06_low_friction.interpretation: Slippery surface (wet / oily): Coulomb 0.05 against blade and board.

M07_high_friction.interpretation: Sticky / grippy surface: Coulomb 0.8 against blade and board.

M08_low_cut_resistance.interpretation: Easy to cut: law-8 cutting energy G_c 5x lower (0.01 J/m^2).

M09_high_cut_resistance.interpretation: Hard to cut (tough): law-8 cutting energy G_c 10x higher (0.5 J/m^2).

M10_light.interpretation: Light (foam-like density): rho 1100 kg/m^3; grid CFL 0.196 at 0.1 ms.
